paragraphs: Rav Yosef son of Rav Sala the Pious.
We always find him under the formula "he explained it before Rav Papa" (targema kamei de-Rav Papa), as in Pesachim 73b, Chullin 74b, Arakhin 33b.[^1][^2][^3]

notes.text: חסידא, “the Pious,” qualifies Sala in the patronymic. Both Rav titles are written fully in the heading.

בשם introduces the recurring formula “he explained it before Rav Papa”; it does not make Rav Papa the source of a transmitted statement. תרגמא here means explained or interpreted. Hyman’s “always” describes his own survey.
The printed locators עג:, עד:, לג: are rendered Pesachim 73b, Chullin 74b and Arakhin 33b.
